commits.summary: Publish the blind caller and PR verification campaign results
commits.body:
The frozen cold, upstream-test and reviewed attempts each qualified 0/20 primaries and 0/10 R. The separate packaging repair bound another original entry and scored 0/1. The URL-only producer stopped before publishing measurements for its five deployments or seventeen questions. The before-reveal Parquet ranking found one of the two named histories; the isolated replay ranked the file and page fourth and fifth and ordinary Stage 2 offered both. The report preserves the original Spring suite, causal scheduler controls, strict helper applications, profiled timezone gap, sixteen stock properties and loader decisions.

Recomputed the campaign scorecard from its receipts, checked all 33 report links and reconciled every one of the 37 submitted jobs with the independent collector. Twenty-seven passed, six failed and four errored before measurement, with passing follow-ups for all ten. The selector found no additional source suites for the final evidence-only change.
